hero.name: Dennis Anchundia
hero.short_bio: I build robust APIs, scalable systems, and applications that prioritize code quality, performance, and user experience.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: Information Technology Engineer specialized in backend software architecture and scalable systems. I have designed and built high-availability RESTful APIs for enterprise environments, managing full lifecycle from conception to production deployment.
about.p2: I master the Java / Spring Boot stack for robust services, complemented with Node.js / TypeScript for orchestration layers and DevOps tooling. My experience includes optimizing PostgreSQL queries with millions of records, integrating microservices, and automating CI/CD pipelines with Docker and GitHub Actions.
about.p3: I work under Clean Code principles, hexagonal architecture, and agile Scrum methodologies, always prioritizing maintainability, performance, and test coverage. Every line of code I write is meant to be tested, scaled, and maintained by teams.
